title: Nf Round4 Primary
objective: Implement and certify the modified Round-4 deep-primary power-basis search, eliminating Round-2 delegation on supported PARI corpus and public timeout vectors

handoff.summary: Correctness checkpoint: an ordinary-Python Ford--Letard power-basis search now handles PARI #2510 and vector 008 without constructive Round-2 fallback. Exact E*F, p-local containment, p-power denominators/index, discriminant change, canonical HNF, and stable stage evidence fail closed; Round 2 remains an optional independent verifier.
risks: Vector 008 remains a measured performance debt: about 20.0s in the power-basis kernel and 22.3s through the strict public wrapper on the shared Linux x64 host.
Multiple modular primary components and higher-residue-field root matching remain explicit unsupported boundaries delegated to Round 2.

Vector 010 now passes the former ramification-degree-decrease and finite-field-root boundaries, but did not complete within a 240-second direct strict run; its next exact characteristic-polynomial stage remains a performance bound.
next_steps: Profile and source-transparently compile the post-root-matching characteristic-polynomial stage that bounds vector 010.
Move repeated exact characteristic-polynomial work toward the source-transparent native boundary; a single degree-32 probe measured about 217ms.
Integrate the public dispatcher/selector separately through the shared integration lane.
